description: Diagnostic module to validate signal enrichment discrimination. Queries mcp_signal_enrichments for each of the 8 signals and reports distinct score count. Must: (1) query DISTINCT score FROM mcp_signal_enrichments WHERE signal_type IN (...) GROUP BY signal_type, (2) flag any signal with <10 distinct values as weak, (3) output JSON report of {signal_type, distinct_count, sample_scores}. Pure read-only, no DB writes. Run against live DuckDB via write_service :8772/query. Helps diagnose why permission_scope, temporal_stability, tool_description_safety show only 4 distinct values.
